tweets: GLP-1 agonists like semaglutide & tirzepatide are reshaping metabolic health — but how do they *actually* work? It’s not magic: satiety signaling + gastric emptying. Here’s the plain-English breakdown 👇
GLP-1 agonists influence metabolic health through mechanisms including satiety signaling and gastric emptying.
These agents can affect feelings of fullness and digestion timing, which may contribute to their effects.
GLP-1 agonists are not simple appetite suppressants and have multiple effects related to metabolism.
They are used in contexts beyond weight loss, addressing aspects of metabolic health.
GLP-1 agonists aren’t for everyone, and they’re not magic bullets. They’re powerful tools when paired with metabolic optimization — diet, activity, sleep, stress management. No quick fixes here.
